assets.name: meal-room

assets.name: meal-scoop

His left hand holds a small cream ceramic rice bowl securely at upper abdomen; his right hand holds a spoon just inside the bowl, scooping a bite of rice and vegetables. Both hands and spoon clearly readable with correct anatomy. Show full head, shoulders, both arms and torso down to hips, with comfortable transparent margins; no legs, chair, table, scenery or text. Bowl and spoon must be part of the complete character cutout. Same refined cel shading, fine dark outlines and warm soft lighting as references. Portrait canvas. This is the base pose of a fixed-camera eating animation; keep head upright, body symmetrical and stable.
